# The Mountain Table
> The Mountain Table is a serene homestay located in the hills of Ulupuni, Wagamon, offering a blend of rustic charm and modern luxury. The site provides guests with various outdoor activities, including jeep safaris, paragliding, trekking, and cycling, alongside amenities like an infinity pool and locally inspired dining. Guests can stay in well-appointed rooms with panoramic views of tea plantations and misty hills. The site also outlines comprehensive booking, cancellation, and sustainability policies to ensure a comfortable and eco-friendly experience.
